Furnace oil

Furnace oil for steady, high heat.

A heavy industrial fuel for plants that need continuous, high-temperature heat. Rerol processes and tests each batch so your team can review the result before it reaches the burner.

Applications

Where furnace oil works.

Suitability depends on the burner, temperature and operating pattern. Share the current setup before switching products.

01

Steam boilers

Steady steam for processing, plant heating and continuous production.

02

Industrial furnaces

Sustained heat for metal treatment and heavy manufacturing.

03

Rotary and vertical kilns

Continuous high heat for cement, ceramics and process industries.

04

Thermic fluid heaters

Controlled heat for processes that need stable operating temperatures.

05

Process heating

Fuel for drying, curing, melting and other industrial heat duties.

06

Planned bulk supply

Tanker or barrel delivery coordinated with storage and production demand.
